standard_prerequisites: fppf cohomology H^1 and G-torsors over Spec(K) for G a smooth commutative group algebraic space over a field K
the torsor [n](P) whose class is n times the class of P in H^1_fppf(Spec(K), G)
smooth schemes/spaces have points over finite separable extensions; quotients by finite constant groups
core_obligations: Every G-torsor P over Spec(K) is smooth over K (a form of G), hence has a point over a finite separable extension L/K of degree n
The canonical morphism P x_K ... x_K P -> [n](P) is symmetric because G is abelian, hence factors through the S_n-quotient
Spec(L)^n/S_n maps to (P x ... x P)/S_n and the left scheme has a K-rational point, so [n](P) is the trivial torsor
proof_roadmap: P is a form of G, so P -> Spec(K) is smooth; pick a closed point over a finite separable L/K, [L:K] = n
Symmetry of the n-fold product morphism under permuting factors follows from commutativity of G; descend to the S_n-quotient
The K-rational point of Spec(L)^n/S_n forces n[P] = 0 in H^1_fppf(Spec(K), G)
